title: CLI: unreadable source files return exit code 0
description:
When a source file is unreadable (permission denied), the CLI reports the error but returns exit code 0 (success).

## Reproduction
```
$ mkdir /tmp/unreadable_test
$ echo "# Test" > /tmp/unreadable_test/secret.md
$ chmod 000 /tmp/unreadable_test/secret.md
$ doc_transformer index /tmp/unreadable_test --output /tmp/out
Error: analysis failed: secret.md: Permission denied (os error 13)
Exit: 0
``"

Expected: Exit code 1 or 2 (error)
Actual: Exit code 0
